title: Mob Loot Box
body:
This mod adds different mob blocks obtained with the Wandering Trader.
Currently, there are only 20 blocks: creeper, skeleton, spider, zombie crate, etc.
Each block has its own loot; they can drop mods, heads, and spawn eggs.
More blocks will be added over time, but only those from mobs that drop drops or have some related effect.
